title: Retained source inventory selector for AOP-005
description: Closed metadata-only discovery of retained sensor/stream capsule inventory and historical source continuity. The launcher fixes deployment and principal. The immutable reader verifies the complete bounded capsule inventory and current deletion/import restrictions before filtering and pagination, then revalidates under the same read allowance. Existing AgentResponseEnvelope and AgentCognitiveEnvelope query/case contracts preserve protected deployment context, including retained historical health. Historical metadata does not establish present liveness or health, physical coverage, absence, origin authentication or source-byte availability. Representative H0 capsule-metadata handles grant no ReadMedia authority. No original-media read, model execution, recovery, publication or effect is inferred. The complete protected page fits 256 KiB or refuses. Native admission remains authoritative.

max_entries.description: Complete stream inventory rows per page, ordered by sensor then stream identity.

anchor.description: Optional exact current deployment authority/effect-history precondition. Historical source metadata never selects historical authority.

continuation.description: Exact native continuation from the preceding page, bound to principal, filters, page size, complete verified inventory, all limits and current authority/effect prefix. No offset, discovery bypass or silent rebase.

max_query_read_bytes.description: Shared metadata payload-byte ceiling, 1..268435456, covering current history, retained capsule metadata and final rereads. Original source media is not read; failed reads invalidate the remaining balance.

max_query_read_objects.description: Shared metadata payload-read-attempt ceiling, 1..65536, including final revalidation. Not an archive filesystem syscall quota.

max_query_results.description: Complete retained stream-inventory ceiling, 1..1024, applied before sensor/stream filtering and pagination. Filtering never bypasses verification or truncates an over-budget inventory. Native traversal separately bounds ledger objects and capsule metadata.

sensor.description: Exact retained sensor identity. Omission selects all sensors. Selection follows complete inventory verification.

stream.description: Exact retained stream identity. Sensor and stream filters are conjunctive. Selection follows complete inventory verification.
